judgments.rationale: Subsection (c) provides that using a hand-held mobile telephone is permissible 'by drivers of a CMV when necessary to communicate with law enforcement officials or other emergency services.' While this qualifies the driver prohibition in § 392.82(a)(1) (C0000), the text does not grant motor carriers an exception to allow or require hand-held mobile telephone use under § 392.82(a)(2) (C0001). Because not every targeted baseline is supported by the source text, the proposal cannot be supported as formulated.

source_spans.quote:
(a)(1) No driver shall use a hand-held mobile telephone while driving a CMV.

(2) No motor carrier shall allow or require its drivers to use a hand-held mobile telephone while driving a CMV.
(c) Emergency exception. Using a hand-held mobile telephone is permissible by drivers of a CMV when necessary to communicate with law enforcement officials or other emergency services.
